title: DevSecOps Action Execution Handoff
description: Models the handoff of an approved remediation action from Prophet Platform to AgentPlane for execution. Prophet Platform proposes and tracks the handoff; AgentPlane executes and issues the receipt. Prophet Platform must not execute actions or issue receipts.

agentplane_execution_request_ref.description: Reference to the AgentPlane execution request submitted after approval.

execution_receipt_ref.description: Reference to the AgentPlane execution receipt. Present only when status=receipt_received.

failure_evidence_ref.description: Reference to failure evidence. Required when status=failed.

requires_receipt.description: If true, execution must produce a verified receipt before remediation can be closed.
